description: Call this tool to write a real .docx file from structured sections. Returns the file path, the number of blocks written and the layout used. Free and unlimited.

date.description: Date line for the letter layout, default today

out_path.description: Where to write the .docx. Defaults to the data directory

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

recipient.description: Addressee block for the letter layout

sections.description: Sections in order. Each one may carry a heading, paragraphs, a bullet or numbered list and a table

table.description: A table: one header row plus rows of cells

style.description: Layout, default plain. plain is the title and the body; letter adds a sender block top right, a date and the addressee; proposal adds a letterhead band and a cover title

title.description: Document title, used as the top heading and the file name

name: doc_create
title: Create a Word document
